hypothesis: E_xc[D]=F_M(q[D])-Ts_M(q[D])-E_H[D], keeping Tr(TD) outside the moment search
moments: Point-charge Coulomb density probes at all nuclear positions, with number gauge and linear dependencies removed; no nuclear-charge weighting in universal objective
input: One bounded CUDA HF determinant, complete stated basis
kinetic_reference: Noninteracting one-body Legendre dual, gives a lower bound even if unconverged
stopping: Density and stationarity residuals; reference energies never used
assessment: Report moment residuals, potential-span error, convergence status and energy error against a new same-basis CUDA physical reference after prediction. No replacement or label-driven parameter changes.
limitations: No general benchmark or world-novelty claim
